facts.text: The hotel sits by Dian Lake in Kunming.
facts.excerpt: Stunning Kunming luxury Hotel by Dian Lake

facts.text: Guest rooms and suites have panoramic views of Dianchi (Dian Lake).
facts.excerpt: We offer 536 luxury guest rooms and suites with panoramic views of Dianchi.

facts.text: The hotel is 40 km from Kunming Airport and close to Dianchi and Xishan (West Mountain).
facts.excerpt: We are 40 km from Kunming Airport and close to attractions such as Dianchi and Xishan.

facts.text: Alongside Dian Lake, the hotel has a lawn and spacious outdoor area used for leisure, weddings and social gatherings.
facts.excerpt: Located alongside Dian Lake with great views and scenic surroundings, InterContinental Kunming features a beautiful lawn and spacious outdoor area great for leisure enjoyment, weddings, or social gatherings.

facts.text: Most rooms have large balconies, and select suites have private recreation rooms.
facts.excerpt: Most rooms offer large balconies, while select suites have private recreation rooms.

facts.text: Premium Rooms and One Bedroom Suites may include a private hot spring.
facts.excerpt: Private Hot Spring

facts.text: One Bedroom Suites may include Dian Lake views.
facts.excerpt: Dian Lake View, Garden View

facts.text: A butterfly theme runs through the whole hotel, echoed by the Butterfly Bar.
facts.excerpt: The Butterfly Bar is echoing the theme of butterfly of whole hotel

facts.text: Shang Tao Chinese Restaurant serves Cantonese dishes and Yunnan flavors, and its seven private rooms are named after phrases from ancient poems praising butterflies.
facts.excerpt: The names of the seven private rooms of this namesake restaurant cleverly borrow from phrases found in ancient poems praising butterflies. Here, you will enjoy feasts of delicious Cantonese dishes and authentic Yunnan flavors.

facts.text: Shang Tao Chinese Restaurant has won the Black Pearl Restaurant Award for seven consecutive years.
facts.excerpt: Shang Tao Chinese Restaurant has won the Black Pearl Restaurant Award for seven consecutive years

facts.text: Each food and beverage outlet has spacious outdoor dining areas.
facts.excerpt: Additionally, each outlet features spacious outdoor dining areas.

facts.text: The Market takes its name from a traditional custom of the Hani people and serves Mediterranean, Asian and Yunnan dishes from open kitchens.
facts.excerpt: The name, "The Market" is derived from a traditional custom of the Hani Tribe. Here, a variety of sumptuous Mediterranean and Asian dishes are on offer, as well as a number of Yunnan delicacies, all prepared in open kitchens

facts.text: The heated indoor pool at the ZEST Fitness Center has expansive views.
facts.excerpt: The heated pool at ZEST Fitness Center, with its clear water and expansive views, is the perfect place to relax.

facts.text: Club InterContinental offers complimentary breakfast, afternoon tea and evening cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Club InterContinental is the perfect retreat to conduct private meetings or enjoy our complimentary breakfast, afternoon tea and evening cocktails.

facts.text: The Grand Ballroom offers 1,600 square meters of space.
facts.excerpt: The Grand Ballroom offers a 1600 sqm space of elegant design.

facts.text: Yunnan Ethnic Village is about 2 km from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Yunnan Ethnic Village-1.24 miles away (2 kilometers)

facts.text: Yunnan Ethnic Village, on the shore of Dianchi Lake, showcases the cultures and traditions of the 26 nations in Yunnan.
facts.excerpt: the park is a window to show the different cultures and traditions of the 26 nations in Yunnan

facts.text: Loaner bikes are available.
facts.excerpt: Loaner bikes

facts.text: Kunming is nicknamed Spring City for its mild and pleasant climate.
facts.excerpt: Nicknamed "Spring City" for its mild and pleasant climate.

facts.text: Complimentary parking is available for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary parking spaces are available for hotel guests

facts.text: The hotel is at No. 5 Yijing Road in Kunming's Xishan District.
facts.excerpt: No. 5 Yijing Road, Xishan District Kunming

facts.text: From the top of West Mountain, the whole of Dianchi Lake is in view.
facts.excerpt: Once stand on the top of West Mountain, the whole Dianchi Lake is in your eyes.
